[SWS_DM_01458] SOVD data representation of units
⌈
The atomic subset
of a SOVD request or response body matching a DiagnosticDataElement with a
unit referenced as defined in Diagnostic Extract Template[3] shall include the unit in
JSON schema according to ASAM SOVD.
